text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — Lattice asked for a tight SEV path across the marketplace listing + their SI integrator. Proposal: a shared channel, an automated bridge command, and a short handoff runbook pinned in the channel.

Owen Chen: +1. Want auto-bridge + a synthesized runbook summary in the channel topic. cc @Redwood Ops Bot for automation options.

Redwood Ops Bot: available for automations. Example commands:
```/partner-bridge create --partner=lattice --sev=P1 --owner=@redwood-oncall```
```/partner-bridge annotate --runbook=https://redwood.runbooks/lattice-sev```. Will also post a starter checklist when channel created.

Samir Rao: Can we standardize severity mappings first? Partners use "Priority 1" vs our P1. Proposed mapping: Partner P1 -> Redwood P1, Partner P2 -> Redwood P2, SI urgent -> Redwood P1 if customer-facing outage. Keep it simple.

Tessa L: Also want a read-only service account for partner SIs to push diagnostics (logs/snapshot) and a short retention window for artifacts. Channel topic should include: runbook shortlink, oncall roster, and rollback trigger definition.

Ben (Lattice Eng): We can commit to 24/7 oncall for true P1s but need explicit handback rules. Our ask: handback only after mitigation and a documented postmortem owner is assigned (max 4h).

Owen Chen: Suggested SEV template for shared channel: 1) Triage summary, 2) Current owner(s), 3) Mitigations in flight, 4) Trigger for rollback (if any), 5) Customer comms owner, 6) Postmortem owner + ETA. We should also note Dedicated customers may need an ops escalation to infra lead.

Maya Patel: OK — I'll create #partner-lattice-sev and invite Lattice SRE + their SI lead. Dry-run this Thursday 09:30 PT to exercise the /partner-bridge flow and the handoff checklist.

Samir Rao: I'll build the 6-point checklist and put a short Google doc in the channel before the dry-run: https://go.redwood/s/partner-sev-checklist (placeholder).

Tessa L: Quick follow: add an automated tag for marketplace listings so product knows when to pause listing updates during an active SEV.

Ben (Lattice Eng): That would help. Also please confirm SI rotation mapping before the drill so we don't miss pages.

Maya Patel: Noted. Action items: Maya create channel + invite (today), Samir checklist (today EOD), Owen wire up the Ops Bot command bindings (tomorrow), Tessa add RBAC/retention notes, Ben confirm SI rotation. Dry-run Thu 09:30 PT.

Redwood Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run Thursday 09:00 PT -> posting agenda in #partner-lattice-sev at 09:10 PT. :robot_face:
